action_summary: Reverted preprocessing to the configuration that produced the best score in the history: IMAGE_SIZE 512 and ImageNet Normalize mean/std, undoing the v16-v21 normalization tweaks that each lowered the score. Added a true ensemble: glob all resnet200d_fold*.pth checkpoints in the public baseline dataset (falling back to the single fold4 checkpoint), load each via a helper that unwraps 'model' dicts and strips 'module.' prefixes and prints missing/unexpected keys, and average the flip-TTA probabilities across all folds in the existing inference loop. Reduced batch size to 64 to keep memory in check with several models resident. Prediction scaling (*100) is kept since it is rank-preserving for AUC.
